package.name: mobile_manipulator_perception
package.description:
Camera and OpenCV perception for mobile manipulator.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - Understand camera frame conventions (optical vs ROS) - See OpenCV image processing pipeline - Learn object detection methods (color, shape, QR) - Practice 2D-to-3D pose estimation
KEY FILES: - object_detector.py: Color and shape detection - qr_detector.py: QR/barcode detection - pose_estimator.py: 2D detection to 3D pose - perception_node.py: Main perception pipeline
DETECTION METHODS (Classical CV, no ML): 1. Color detection: HSV filtering 2. Shape detection: Contour analysis 3. QR detection: pyzbar library 4. Pose estimation: Known object size + pinhole model
